description: Robinhood Chain deployer launch history (paginated) — the FULL enumerable token list for one deployer, enriched with live MC, peak MC + peak_mc_at and liquidity. Distinct from rhc_deployer_profile, which caps recent tokens at 50 and is a profile read. total is the deployer's lifetime tokens_deployed, with has_more for paging. NOTE: sort=peak_mc_usd re-orders the REQUESTED PAGE only (peak MC lives in another table) and the response echoes sort_scope:'page' to say so — it is not a global top-tokens ranking. Unknown wallets return 200 with is_deployer: false. Tier: BASIC.

sort.description: first_seen_at (default, newest first, applied in Postgres) or peak_mc_usd (page-scoped re-sort)

name: rhc_deployer_tokens
